Class Conditions

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.relational.core.sql.Conditions
public abstract class Conditions extends Object
用于生成通用Condition的工厂。
Since:
1.1
Author:
Mark Paluch，Jens Schauder，孟作主，Daniele Canteri
